skills.name: hermes_computer_status
skills.description: Check Hermes CUA installation and desktop permissions without performing a desktop task.

skills.name: hermes_computer_task
skills.description: Delegate a user-requested visual desktop task to Hermes CUA: observe applications, click, type, scroll and verify outcomes. Requires a ready backend. Returns a supervised job ID; use check_agent_job for output and cancel_agent_job to stop. Only one computer task runs at a time. Keeps Hermes permissions; blocked approvals must be reported, not bypassed.

prompt.description: The authorized desktop task and target application.

workspace.description: Absolute existing directory for the supervised Hermes job.
